final.paper_method: kallisto v0.45 counts -> DESeq2 v1.28.0, corrected using limma v3.44.1 for library prep batch and sequencing flow-cell lane (S4.4.1.p2)

factors.strain: HMDP inbred strain; mice of each strain randomized to SED or TRN (S2.1.p1)

final.paper_results: No per-tissue DEG counts in text. caveats: The paper gives no per-tissue DEG count in the text (figures S11A/S12A only): only an average of ~500 DEGs per tissue, BAT the most, liver and heart fewer.
The paper's batch and flow-cell lane adjustment cannot be reproduced.
The GEO deposit has 50 strains x 1 animal per arm per tissue; the paper describes 100 strains.

Housing is aliased with exercise: TRN mice were individually housed with a wheel, SED mice were group-housed 1-4 per cage (S4.2.2.p1). Housing cannot be separated from TRN vs SED in any model, so every result is a TRN-plus-single-housing effect, not wheel running alone.

Strain-blocked quadriceps gives ~4,000 DEGs, about equal to BAT, whereas the paper says BAT had the most DEGs (S2.8.p1); in the unblocked sensitivity model BAT (2,037) clearly exceeds quadriceps (378).

reasoning: The paper's estimand and method are reproduced on the deposited data with declared deviations (no batch/lane, strain blocking).
